knowledgePoints.title: 一、基本拼写规则
knowledgePoints.content: 动词-ing形式的基本拼写规则：

subPoints.title: 一般情况下
subPoints.content:
直接在动词词尾加-ing
work → working, study → studying

subPoints.title: 以不发音的e结尾
subPoints.content:
去e加-ing
dance → dancing, make → making, write → writing

subPoints.title: 以重读闭音节结尾
subPoints.content:
双写末尾辅音字母加-ing
sit → sitting, run → running, swim → swimming

subPoints.title: 以ie结尾
subPoints.content:
变ie为y加-ing
die → dying, lie → lying, tie → tying

subPoints.title: 以ie结尾
subPoints.content:
去e加-ing
see → seeing, agree → agreeing

subPoints.title: 特殊变化
subPoints.content:
travel → traveling/travelling（英式双写，美式不双写）
quarrel → quarreling/quarrelling

exercises.question: The talented chef, who is well-known for his innovative dishes, is busy ______ (make) a special meal for the VIP guests tonight.
Having spent years ______ (study) migratory patterns, the biologist published a paper ______ (detail) how climate change disrupts bird navigation.
exercises.explanation: study以y结尾，直接加-ing；detail以l结尾，直接加-ing

exercises.question: After ______ (take) a long-awaited vacation, the hard-working businessman returned to the office, full of energy and ready to tackle new challenges.
Despite warning about the risks, the entrepreneur insisted on ______ (pursue) her controversial business model.
When I passed by the playground, I saw the athlete, who had won many championships, ______ (run) at a high speed, training for the upcoming important competition.
exercises.explanation: run以重读闭音节结尾，双写n加-ing

exercises.question: Satellite networks, ______ (orbit) Earth continuously, play a crucial role in monitoring weather patterns.
The company, aiming to expand its market share, is ______ (plan) to transfer some of its key operations to a more strategic location.
exercises.explanation: plan以重读闭音节结尾，双写n加-ing

exercises.question: Just as we were discussing the marketing plan, the unexpected problem suddenly ______ (occur), forcing us to change our original strategy.
exercises.explanation: 一般过去时，以重读闭音节结尾，双写r加ed
